title: Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) Associate [Open to Tier 1 & 2 applicants]
description:
Tiered Approach
In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:
Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates
Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.
Background
UNDP is the leading United Nations organization fighting to tackle the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change on a global scale. Working with our broad network of experts, host governments, and partners in 170 countries, we help nations to build integrated, lasting solutions for people and the planet. UNDP has been working in Afghanistan for more than 50 years on climate change and resilience, gender, governance, health, livelihoods, and the rule of law.
Following the power shift in August 2021, the situation for the country remains largely uncertain and fragile, with approximately seventy percent of the population facing multifaceted vulnerabilities affecting their well-being, human security, and long-term development. While nearly 20 million people are estimated to be acutely food insecure, women and girls are increasingly stripped of their rights to education, employment, and free participation in public life that will have irreversible socioeconomic consequences. Over the recent years, the international humanitarian assistance has played a vital role in averting a socioeconomic collapse by providing lifesaving, resilience-building, and livelihoods-sustaining assistance to millions of people, hundreds of critical healthcare and educational centers, and tens of thousands of small and medium enterprises, often managed by women. Nevertheless, the humanitarian challenge in Afghanistan, which is one of the biggest in the world, and basic human needs and priorities remain extremely high.
To help tackle the pressing challenges of rebuilding livelihoods and climate resilience, UNDP is designing fit-for-purpose portfolios of programs to create new livelihoods, income opportunities, basic services, and to build resilience against climate-induced natural calamities that continue to haunt millions of households in the country.
Afghanistan remains one of the most gender-unequal countries in the world, with women facing systemic challenges hindering their access to education and employment opportunities in the public sector and restricting their participation in public life. UNDP remains committed to women's empowerment through capacity-building initiatives, livelihoods, and self-employment employment support, enhancing gender-responsive decision-making at community level, and supporting local communities to include women, in line with UNSCR 1325 (Women, Peace, and Security).
UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. This is a recognition of the interconnected nature of development risks and crises that the world is facing and that calls for assembling multidisciplinary teams for an integrated and systemic response. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.
As a trusted, long-term partner of The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria (Global Fund, GF), UNDP’s value proposition lies in providing an integrated package of development solutions to strengthen institutions to deliver health services. Through its contributions as interim Principal Recipient and provider of technical assistance in over 53 countries since 2003, UNDP’s provision of integrated policy, implementation and capacity development support to countries has yielded significant health and development results in challenging operating environments. In Afghanistan, UNDP is the interim Principal Recipient (PR) for HIV, tuberculosis, malaria and health systems, with a budget of approximately $59 million for Grant Cycle 8. For effective implementation of the Global Fund resources, UNDP Afghanistan has established a Program Management Unit (PMU), which is responsible for the day-to-day overall programme management, risk management, policy guidance, financial accountability, procurement of goods, including health products and services, strengthening of the national pharmaceutical and laboratory supply chain systems.
Under the direct supervision of the Project Manager, the Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) Associate will provide administrative, coordination and programme support to the implementation of the Resilient and Sustainable Systems for Health (RSSH) component of the Global Fund grant. The incumbent applies established UNDP rules, policies and procedures and the grant agreement, and works with the PMU team, Sub-recipients (SRs) and national counterparts
Scope of Work
1. Provides administrative and programme support to the implementation of the RSSH component of the Global Fund grant, including the following tasks:
Maintain day-to-day communication with MoPH counterparts and SRs to follow up on scheduled RSSH activities (laboratory systems, HMIS/DHIS2, health products management and supply chain), and relay requests and queries.
Compile inputs for RSSH annual work plans and budgets using established templates and track their status.
Prepare invitations, agendas, minutes and action-point lists for RSSH meetings, task force sessions, workshops and trainings, and arrange the related logistics.
Prepare and process routine requests and supporting documents (e.g., travel, payment, procurement and HR requests) in coordination with the PMU operations teams, in line with UNDP procedures.
Maintain RSSH records, document registers and electronic and hard-copy filing.
2.Supports monitoring and reporting of RSSH activities, including the following tasks:
Update and maintain trackers of RSSH activities, deliverables and indicators, and report delays or discrepancies to the supervisor.
Assist in monitoring visits to RSSH sites and record observations in standard formats.
Compile data and inputs for programme reports (e.g., PUDR, annual and UNDP reports) using established templates, and check SR submissions for completeness against checklists.
Maintain RSSH asset and inventory registers and prepare asset transfer documentation in line with donor and UNDP policy.
Compile documents requested for audits and keep track of the status of audit recommendations.
3.Support partnerships and resource mobilization.
Ensure regular communication and coordination with partners, project counterparts, stakeholders, and beneficiaries; and develop and maintain effective mechanisms for integrating and responding to their feedback and insight.
Support resource mobilization initiatives.
4.Supports knowledge sharing and capacity development in the PMU, including the following tasks:
Compile and file documents, lessons learnt and good practices on RSSH implementation for use by the PMU.
Assist in organizing training and capacity development sessions for MoPH, SRs and CSOs on RSSH-related processes.
The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for efficient functioning.
Institutional Arrangement
The RSSH Associate will work under the direct supervision of the Project Manager, Global Fund PMU, in close collaboration with the Project Specialists. The incumbent works under general guidance, apply established procedures and refers to complex or non-routine issues to the supervisor.

description:
Job Summary
The ICT Assistant provides day-to-day ICT support within the Mission, contributing to the functionality and continuity of ICT systems and services, in line with INTERSOS standards and under the guidance of HQ ICT Unit.
Support the daily operation and maintenance of ICT systems, providing first-line troubleshooting and user support. Assist with ICT asset management and basic technical tasks, ensuring compliance with INTERSOS policies.
Provide first-level ICT support to staff (hardware, software, connectivity)
• Install and configure basic ICT equipment (computers, printers, smartphones, simple network setups).
• Assist in ICT asset management (registration, tagging, inventory).
• Support in maintaining backups and password/user account management under supervision.
• Seek guidance from HQ ICT Unit when issues go beyond local capacity.
• Assist in the local procurement process of ICT goods by providing technical details when requested.
• Perform other ICT-related tasks as assigned by supervisor.

Secondary education with technical training. ICT-related certifications are an asset but not required.
1 year of experience in ICT or technical functions; internships or volunteering experience are desirable.
• Ability to use Google Workspace and provide routine support and troubleshooting (Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet, Forms, Calendar).
• Basic installation and troubleshooting of hardware and operating systems (computers, printers, smartphones).
• Basic understanding and application of IT security practices (backups, password management, antivirus).
• ICT asset management: registration, tagging, and inventory tracking.
• Basic networking: LAN/Wi-Fi setup and troubleshooting of routers/access points.
• Ability to seek guidance from HQ ICT Unit when advanced issues arise.
Fluency in mission language essential; knowledge of local working language desirable; technical English preferable.
Strong technical problem-solving skills.
• Communication skills, able to explain basic technical issues clearly.
• Ability to learn and work under supervision.
• Organisational and time management skills.
• Flexibility and adaptability.
• Teamwork and cooperation.
• Commitment to INTERSOS principles and humanitarian values.
Experience with Google Admin Panel.
• Experience with RMM tools (e.g., NinjaOne) and endpoint protection (e.g., SentinelOne).
• Experience with networking systems (Zyxel, Ubiquiti).

· Travel to customer sites and trade shows as required.

Master's degree in Computer Sciences /electronics engineering or related discipline

· Good project management skills
· Knowledge of Flex cube system
· Excellent interpersonal skills
· Ability to work to tight deadlines
· A problem solver
· Good presentation skills
· Experience of staff management
· A team player
· 5 years IT experience with excellent IT network, hardware and software skills.
· Should be well versed in English. Dari, Pashto will be advantage but not essential.

title: INFORMATION SYSTEMS ASSISTANT
company: UNAMA - United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan
description:
Org. Setting and Reporting
This position is located in the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) Kabul Main Office. The Information Systems Assistant reports to the Chief of Unit, UNAMA Field Technology Section.
Responsibilities
Within delegated authority and under the direct supervision of Chief FTS, the Information Systems Assistant will perform the following responsibilities: • Plans and directs all major information systems projects within the mission, monitoring the progress of the systems analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of new, moderately complex systems, and/or, participates as a member of a team with responsibility for major components of the more complex systems; • Manages the budget of the Information Systems unit, formulating and monitoring budget allocations and expenditures, verifying funding and ensuring no overrun occurs; • Develops technical specifications for the procurement of equipment and contractual services, and coordinates the technical evaluation of offers and proposals received; • Develops and recommends strategies to implement global information systems projects originating out of DFS/ICTD and the mission; • Develops, implements and monitors information systems standards, guidelines and procedures; • Develops detailed systems and other functional specifications and user documentation for system as required; • Provides specialized advice to users, analysing users’ requirements and translating these into new applications; determines application systems integration and linkage issues; • Maintains, upgrades or enhances existing user systems; troubleshoots and provides continuing support, to include resolving difficult problems, advising on the use of new techniques, monitoring transactions to measure performance and continued effectiveness of assigned systems, etc; • Develops training materials, operating and user manuals; trains staff in assigned systems; • Develops disaster recovery plans relating to information systems and ensures appropriate planning and training of those responsible; • Researches, analyses and evaluates new technologies and makes recommendations for their deployment; • Participates in writing reports and papers on systems-related topics, system requirements, information strategy etc; • Provides professional leadership and work direction for the Unit, develops the yearly work plan, mentors and supervises personnel of the Unit. • Handles all aspects of contract administration including establishment of service level agreements with vendors and chargeback policy for users. • Provides guidance to, and may supervise, new/junior staff, consultants, etc. Internetworking & Infrastructure • Develops plans for major IT systems projects within the mission, monitoring the progress of the design, installation and commissioning of the various systems; • Leads the team in the operation and maintenance of internetworking systems that includes routers and switches, operating systems platforms, database management systems, servers, workstations, and related equipment; • Devises and administers disaster recovery plans; provides training for support staff to implement these plans to ensure optimal readiness; • Responsible for the proper implementation of backup and recovery procedures • Maintains a regular review of the network resources access control, data security including AI threats and unauthorized use of AI and server and data stores security systems, including network segmentation using Cisco ISE and Cisco Firepower Threat Defense (FTD). • Ensures all information security systems are properly configured and maintained, including Check Point and Cisco Firepower firewalls, IPS and malware protection. • Oversees the user access control for network resources and overall network security, including identity-based access with Cisco ISE and 802.1X integrated with Microsoft Entra ID and Entra ID device management, configuration and scripting. • Manages internet traffic across multiple ISP links, including load balancing and traffic rerouting; • Identifies and analyses security incidents using Microsoft Defender and firewall logs; • Provides technical design for CCTV, perimeter intrusion detection and video analytics systems in coordination with UNDSS and UNGSC. • Contributes to the collection and analysis of data as well as identification of trends or pattern and provides draft insight graphs, charts, tables and report using data visualization methods for data-driven planning, decision-making, presentation and reporting. • Documents requirements and background information used for date analysis. • Performs other related duties as required.
Competencies
Professionalism: Shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Commitment to implementing the goal of gender equality by ensuring the equal participation and full involvement of women and men in all aspects of work. Planning & Organizing: Develops clear goals that are consistent with agreed strategies. Identifies priority activities and assignments; adjusts priorities as required. Allocates appropriate amount of time and resources for completing work. Foresees risks and allows for contingencies when planning. Monitors and adjusts plans and actions as necessary. Uses time efficiently. Technological Awareness: Keeps abreast of available technology. Understands applicability and limitations of technology to the work of the office. Actively seeks to apply technology to appropriate tasks. Shows willingness to learn new technology.
Education
Secondary school, technical school, university and other courses and training programmes relating to the work. High school diploma or equivalent and certification/diploma in other supplemental academic qualifications, training in Information Systems is required. Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) and GIAC Certified Incident Handler Certifications are required. Other related industry-standard training courses and certifications are desirable.
Job - Specific Qualification
Not available.
Work Experience
Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) Certification is required. GIAC Certified Incident Handler Certification is required. At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in Information Systems and Technology, or related area, including enterprise network, wireless and ICT security operations. Experience in Information Systems and Technology within the United Nations system in support of peacekeeping operations is required. Experience in carrying out programmatic/administrative tasks necessary for the functioning of the Unit including preparation of cost estimates/budgets, reporting on budget/programme performance, contracting vendor services is required. The minimum years of relevant experience is reduced to five (5) years for candidates who possess a first level University degree.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this job opening, English is required. French is desirable. The table below shows the minimum required level for each skill in these languages, according to the UN Language Framework (please consult
https://languages.un.org
for details).

title: Product Engineer (PM)
description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $23.08 to $34.62 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.
Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.
We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.
We're looking for a Product Engineer to own a pod's output end-to-end: strategy, specs, QA, and enough technical depth to unblock engineers or write the code yourself when that's the fastest path forward. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you've been waiting for a PM role that doesn't ask you to leave your technical background at the door, this is it.
What you'll own
Own the roadmap for your pod: define what gets built, kill low-leverage work, and protect your engineers' time and focus
Write specs that start with the problem, not the solution, and ship every brief with a clear success criterion
Participate technically: read the codebase, debug independently, and ship small things when it's faster than context-switching an engineer
Own QA end-to-end: test plans, regression passes, release sign-off, and post-deploy monitoring in Sentry and Grafana
Keep the pod moving: fast decisions, async-first communication, and zero ambiguity about what's next
Close the feedback loop between customers, data, and product direction, and hold yourself accountable to the KPIs you define
You'll thrive here if...
You've shipped production code before and you're honest with yourself about your technical depth
You treat a spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not a document to execute against
You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.
Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.
You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."
You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.
You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.
You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.
What we're looking for
3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment
A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase
Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state
Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off
Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.
Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.
Available in EST
What working here actually looks like
High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.
The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.
We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.
What we stand for
We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us
We figure it the f**k out
We go to war on our problems quickly
We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.
We're fun AF
About Search Atlas
Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

title: AI QA Trainer – LLM Evaluation
description:
Are you an AI QA expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into enterprise-grade platforms. With rigorous evaluation data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world-class education, keep pace with cutting-edge research, and streamline workflows for teams everywhere. That quality begins with you—we need your expertise to harden model reasoning and reliability.
We’re looking for AI QA trainers who live and breathe model evaluation, LLM safety, prompt robustness, data quality assurance, multilingual and domain-specific testing, grounding verification, and compliance/readiness checks. You’ll challenge advanced language models on tasks like hallucination detection, factual consistency, prompt-injection and jailbreak resistance, bias/fairness audits, chain-of-reasoning reliability, tool-use correctness, retrieval-augmentation fidelity, and end-to-end workflow validation—documenting every failure mode so we can raise the bar.
On a typical day, you will converse with the model on real-world scenarios and evaluation prompts, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, design and run test plans and regression suites, build clear rubrics and pass/fail criteria, capture reproducible error traces with root-cause hypotheses, and suggest improvements to prompt engineering, guardrails, and evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall, faithfulness, toxicity, and latency SLOs). You’ll also partner on adversarial red-teaming, automation (Python/SQL), and dashboarding to track quality deltas over time.
A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, statistics, or a related field is ideal; shipped QA for ML/AI systems, safety/red-team experience, test automation frameworks (e.g., PyTest), and hands-on work with LLM eval tooling (e.g., OpenAI Evals, RAG evaluators, W&B) signal fit. Skills that stand out include: evaluation rubric design, adversarial testing/red-teaming, regression testing at scale, bias/fairness auditing, grounding verification, prompt and system-prompt engineering, test automation (Python/SQL), and high-signal bug reporting. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.
Ready to turn your QA expertise into the quality backbone for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.
We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

About the Company & Role Our client is a well-established business operating in the commercial interiors and construction sector, specialising in the delivery of customised joinery and interior solutions for various commercial projects. The business works across different stages of project delivery, from initial planning and costing through to manufacturing and installation, with a strong focus on quality, precision, and efficient project execution. They are looking for an Estimator who will support their estimating operations by preparing accurate cost calculations, reviewing project requirements, and assisting with tender submissions. In this role, you will work with architectural drawings, project specifications, supplier quotations, and estimating documentation to ensure that all project costs and details are properly accounted for. You will also use an established ERP system to manage estimating information and coordinate with internal teams to support smooth project execution. This is a great opportunity for someone with commercial joinery estimating experience who is detail-oriented, organised, and comfortable working within a structured remote team.

Identify scope gaps, discrepancies, exclusions, and potential cost considerations.
Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations to support accurate project costing.
Assist in preparing detailed and competitive tender submissions within established deadlines.
Encode, update, and maintain estimating information, project details, and costing records using Innergy ERP.
Review quantities, calculations, pricing, and project information to ensure accuracy before submission.
Coordinate with internal teams regarding project requirements, estimating details, and clarifications.
Maintain organised and accurate estimating documentation and records.
Follow established estimating procedures and contribute to improving the accuracy and efficiency of the estimating process.

ERP data management

Organisation and time management

Problem-solving and analytical skills

Innergy ERP
Microsoft Teams

Microsoft Office Suite
Required Qualifications & Experience At least 2 years of experience in commercial joinery estimating, construction estimating, or a closely related estimating role.
Hands-on experience using Innergy ERP is mandatory.
Practical experience preparing quantity take-offs, cost estimates, and tender submissions.
Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, construction plans, specifications, and project documentation.
Understanding of commercial joinery materials, components, manufacturing processes, and project requirements.
Experience obtaining supplier quotations and working with project costing information.

title: IT Technician – ISP Network & Field Operations
description:
Role Summary
The IT Technician is responsible for managing the installation and troubleshooting of Wireless, Microwave, and VSAT links. The role includes resolving issues related to LAN network devices and addressing computer-related problems for customers through in-person support, phone consultations, or remote assistance. Additionally, the IT Technician provides technical support regarding computer operating systems, software applications, email configuration, installation processes, printing solutions, and the maintenance of customer LAN networks.

Duties and Responsibilities
Perform installation, activation, and troubleshooting of wireless links in accordance with company guidelines.
Execute the installation, activation, and troubleshooting of microwave links following established protocols.
Conduct installation, activation, and troubleshooting of VSAT links while adhering to company policies.
Install and configure LAN network devices to meet customer requirements effectively.
Troubleshoot LAN network devices and provide the best solution in case of second option availability.
Conduct surveys for network projects, arrange requirements, and implement solutions as needed.
DVR camera wiring, installation, and configuring based on the requirement.
UAT wireless base stations maintenance and resolving 1st level base station issues (in cooperation with Head Office)
Installing Wire and Wireless equipment at UA wireless base stations and ensuring 100% functionality upon completion.
Integrating technical solutions successfully done on-site and sharing it with other team members for future use.
Detailed daily and weekly reports to under-assigned manager.

Job Requirements
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science and/ or relevant field.
A minimum of 3 years of experience in network installation and troubleshooting or a relevant field.
Relevant certifications (e.g., Cisco CCNA, MCITP, or equivalent) will be considered an advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical information effectively.
Full understanding and speaking of Dari, Pashto, and English.
Ability to ride a motorcycle and be comfortable using it when required for work-related tasks
Competencies (in order of importance)
Dependability — The job requires being reliable, responsible, dependable, and fulfilling obligations.
Attention to Detail — The job requires being careful about detail and thorough in completing work tasks.
Cooperation — The job requires being pleasant with others on the job and displaying a good-natured, cooperative attitude.
Analytical Thinking — The job requires analyzing information and using logic to address work-related issues and problems.
Integrity — The job requires being honest and ethical.

Submission Guidelines
Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their applications by Dec 15, 2026 . To apply, please send your updated CV to vacancies@uatelecom.af
In the subject line of your email, please ensure you include the Vacancy Number and Desired Province. e.g: ( UAT-VA-IT-2170-J - Province Name ).
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the written test or interview process.
Note: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

title: IT Manager / Managed IT Services (Open to Individuals & Companies)
salary: As per the Organization's salary scale
description:
Job Summary
Position Summary: Ariana Medical Complex invites qualified individual IT professionals and eligible IT companies or service providers to apply for the management and support of the hospital’s information technology systems.
The selected individual or service provider will be responsible for planning, managing, maintaining, securing, and improving the hospital’s IT infrastructure and services. These services must support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational activities while ensuring system reliability, information security, confidentiality of patient data, and continuity of essential hospital services.
Applicants may apply under one of the following categories:
Category A – Individual IT Manager: An experienced IT professional responsible for managing the hospital’s IT operations and supervising the hospital’s IT staff.
Category B – IT Company / Service Provider: A qualified company that provides IT management services through a designated IT manager and an appropriately skilled technical team under an agreement with the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Strategic Leadership and IT Governance
Develop and implement an IT strategy aligned with the hospital’s objectives and healthcare service requirements.
Establish, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, technical standards, and operational controls.
Advise hospital management on technology investments, digital transformation, system improvements, and IT-related risks.
Develop an annual IT work plan, including priorities, resource requirements, maintenance schedules, and improvement activities.
Ensure IT operations support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational departments.
B. IT Operations and Infrastructure
Manage and maintain servers, computer networks, databases, applications, workstations, printers, scanners, switches, cameras, and related equipment.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and proper functioning of critical hospital IT systems.
Manage network architecture, routing, connectivity, wireless networks, internet services, email systems, and internal communications.
Coordinate installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of IT equipment.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software, licenses, systems, and related assets.
Minimize service interruptions and coordinate timely resolution of technical problems.
C. Information Security and Data Protection
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hospital information and patient records.
Implement appropriate access controls, user account management, password policies, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
Establish and maintain regular data backup, restoration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Monitor and address cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, malware, and other security incidents.
Ensure that access to patient information is restricted to authorized personnel and permitted purposes.
Report significant security incidents promptly to the designated hospital authority.
Ensure that hospital data is not copied, transferred, disclosed, or used without proper authorization.
D. Systems Development and Improvement
Assess, recommend, install, configure, and maintain suitable hardware, software, and technology solutions.
Support the effective operation and improvement of hospital information systems, including clinical, administrative, financial, and other approved platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve hospital services.
Coordinate system upgrades, software updates, equipment replacement, and technical projects.
Ensure that changes to critical systems are properly authorized, documented, tested, and implemented.
E. IT Support and Team Management
Provide or coordinate timely technical support to all hospital departments.
Supervise, guide, and evaluate hospital IT staff, where applicable.
Ensure proper allocation of IT duties, technical coverage, staff development, and performance monitoring.
Establish a system for receiving, recording, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT support requests.
Provide advanced technical assistance for complex IT and system-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical coverage for critical hospital services, including agreed arrangements for urgent and after-hours support.
F. Budget, Procurement, and Vendor Management
Prepare or contribute to the annual IT budget, equipment replacement plan, and maintenance requirements.
Recommend cost-effective procurement of IT equipment, software, licenses, and technical services.
Coordinate with authorized hospital departments regarding procurement specifications, vendor evaluation, and technical acceptance.
Manage technical relationships with internet providers, software vendors, equipment suppliers, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance, warranties, service agreements, licenses, and maintenance commitments.
Ensure that procurement and expenditure recommendations are submitted through the hospital’s approved authorization procedures.
G. Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and approved information security procedures.
Maintain updated technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, equipment inventories, access records, and maintenance logs.
Prepare regular reports covering system availability, support requests, incidents, cybersecurity risks, completed activities, and proposed improvements.
Report major risks, service disruptions, resource gaps, and unresolved technical issues to the designated hospital authority.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by hospital leadership within the approved scope of work.
2. Confidentiality and Ownership of Hospital Information
The selected individual or company must:
Sign the required confidentiality and data protection undertaking before receiving access to hospital systems or information.
Use hospital data and systems solely for authorized purposes.
Maintain appropriate safeguards for patient information, employee records, financial information, and other confidential hospital data.
Refrain from retaining, disclosing, transferring, or using hospital information after termination of the engagement, except where expressly authorized or legally required.
Ensure that all hospital data, configurations, documentation, credentials, and other hospital-owned information remain under the hospital’s control.
Return hospital property and transfer all required records, documentation, credentials, and system access arrangements upon termination or completion of the assignment.
3. Deliverables and Performance Indicators
The selected individual or company will be expected to provide the following deliverables according to an agreed implementation schedule:
No.
Deliverable
Performance Indicator
1
Initial IT assessment and improvement plan
Assessment and prioritized action plan submitted and approved
2
IT asset and system inventory
Inventory maintained and updated
3

Preventive maintenance conducted and documented
4
IT support and incident management
Requests recorded, tracked, and handled within agreed service levels
5
Data backup and recovery plan
Backups monitored and restoration tests documented
6
Information security measures
Access controls reviewed and security incidents reported
7
IT documentation
Essential technical documentation maintained and updated
8
Periodic performance reports
Reports submitted according to the agreed reporting schedule

Complete handover completed at the end of the engagement
Specific uptime targets, response times, resolution targets, and other service-level indicators shall be agreed upon in the contract or service agreement, taking into account the hospital’s operational requirements and available resources.

Job Requirements
4. Additional Requirements for Individual Applicants
Individual applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is an advantage.
At least five years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least two years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Experience in server administration, network management, cybersecurity, backup systems, disaster recovery, and IT support.
Experience managing enterprise-level infrastructure; experience in a hospital or other healthcare institution is an advantage.
Strong leadership, planning, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
High professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality and data protection.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in the languages required for the assignment.
Ability to provide the services and meet the attendance, availability, and reporting requirements agreed with the hospital.
5. Additional Requirements for IT Companies / Service Providers
Companies applying for this assignment must provide evidence of their ability to deliver reliable IT management services in a hospital environment.
Minimum requirements include:
Valid business registration and authorization to provide IT-related services under applicable Afghan laws and regulations.
Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure management, technical support, networking, cybersecurity, systems maintenance, or related services.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.
You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.
Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.
How it works
Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
Requirements
2+ years of professional software engineering
Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
Regular use of an AI coding tool
Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
At least 10 hours a week, starting now
A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)
Nice to have
Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
Experience building agent tasks or RL environments
Terms
Between US$400 - US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join Oportun’s Model Risk Management team and help provide independent oversight of models used across the business. You’ll evaluate model design, methodology, assumptions, implementation, performance, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure models are appropriate, well-controlled, and aligned with Oportun’s risk-management standards.
This is a senior individual contributor role that combines quantitative analysis, independent model validation, governance, and cross-functional influence. You’ll work closely with model developers, Risk, Data Science, Compliance, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders to challenge model approaches, identify material risks, and strengthen model risk practices across Oportun.
At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.
What You'll Do
Your day-to-day
You’ll independently review and validate statistical, machine learning, and decisioning models used across Oportun, including models supporting consumer credit loss forecasting, liquidity and funding, and capital markets activities.
You’ll assess model methodology, assumptions, data quality, feature selection, implementation, performance, stability, and limitations.
You’ll perform quantitative testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, back-testing, and other validation activities.

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on the financial backbone of Gusto's money movement — the ledger, reconciliation, and reporting systems that account for every dollar, and the payment profile that determines how employers fund payroll and how employees and contractors get paid. title: AI Research Engineer
description:
About Syd Life AI
We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living .
Syd , our companion , draws on 2.7 million+ peer-reviewed studies and 14.3 billion+ person-years of longitudinal data , and turns that evidence into action across nine dimensions of life quality . Every recommendation traces back to its evidence . Syd is available in 30 languages and deployed in 26 countries .
Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA .
Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity .
The role
Syd is looking for an AI Research Engineer to join the AI & Research team and work directly with the team lead on open problems across the full range of Syd's work , from the intelligence members interact with to the models , data and research systems behind it . AI tools write most of the code in our team , and you will use them every day . Your contribution is the question you ask , the experiment you design , the measurement you trust and the decision you can defend . Autonomy is high : you choose problems and propose ideas , with direction and review from the team lead .
What you bring
A PhD in a quantitative or life science field , such as neuroscience , mathematics , physics , biomedical engineering , statistics or computational biology , or an equivalent record of original research that is active and recent .
First-hand work with real , imperfect data , and confidence with study design , effect sizes , uncertainty , baselines and calibration .
A first-principles understanding of how large language models are trained and adapted ( pre-training , SFT , LoRA , distillation , PPO and GRPO ) , with hands-on practice in at least one .
Evidence discipline : you state what result would prove you wrong before you run the experiment , and report negative results as readily as positive ones .
Daily use of coding agents and frontier models , with a clear way of checking their output .
Clear , concise written English and comfort working autonomously in a remote team .
What you will do
Design new behaviours , memory and tools for language model agents that support members across every dimension of their life quality .
Design evaluations before a feature is built , with automated judges validated against human review .
Build methods that turn the scientific literature into structured , source-checked evidence .
Train predictive models on large real-world datasets , with attention to calibration , bias and validity across populations .
Fine-tune and evaluate open and closed models where a specialised model serves people well .
Terms
Remote , open to candidates anywhere in the world . Consulting agreement with equity .
How to apply
Apply at careers.syd.life/careers/ai-research-engineer , with a research sample and a one-page note as described on the page . Every candidate completes an online assessment and a 48-hour task before any interview .

Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity .
The role
Syd is looking for a hands-on QA engineer to build and own a reliable testing process for our iOS and Android app . You will combine automation with focused manual testing to catch issues earlier , make releases more dependable and improve the member experience . The role covers the whole app , including onboarding , core member journeys , AI conversations , activity recommendations and notifications . Our current app languages are English , Japanese and Arabic .
What you bring
Practical experience testing mobile apps on both iOS and Android .
Experience building and maintaining automated tests , with programming skills sufficient to investigate failures and keep the test suite dependable .
Experience with API testing , version control and running tests within continuous integration and release workflows .
Strong exploratory testing skills and judgement about which checks to automate and which need human review .
Clear written English for test plans , bug reports and communication with the team .
The ability to prioritise work , explain risks and own a QA process with limited supervision .
What you will do
Map critical member journeys and build a practical testing strategy based on member impact and release risk .
Build and maintain automated smoke and regression tests for critical mobile journeys and APIs .
Run exploratory and regression testing on real iOS and Android devices .
Test AI conversations through repeatable scenarios and agreed quality criteria .
Check localisation across English , Japanese and Arabic , including right-to-left layouts .
Log clear , reproducible issues in Jira and provide concise release-readiness reports .
Terms
Remote , open to candidates anywhere in the world . Consulting agreement with equity .
How to apply
Apply at careers.syd.life/careers/qa-engineer . Every candidate completes an online assessment and a 48-hour task before any interview .

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform.

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.
At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.
About the On-Prem Team
The On-Prem team ships CircleCI Server, our self-hosted CI/CD platform for customers who need to run everything inside their own infrastructure: regulated industries, air-gapped environments, and teams with strict data residency and compliance requirements. Our mission is to deliver an on-premises CircleCI that is secure, highly available, and easy to install, upgrade, and support.
Our team serves two kinds of customers: the organizations that run Server, and the CircleCI engineering teams whose services ship inside it. Beyond the product itself, we own the tooling and infrastructure that let those teams package, test, and release their services into Server and keep them current. As a Staff Engineer here, you'll care as much about the internal release experience as about making Server reliable and easy to operate for external customers.
What You'll Do
Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how we approach and solve problems.
Make shipping into Server easy for every team. Own the platform strategy, setting the technical direction for the tooling, test infrastructure, and release automation that CircleCI teams use to develop and maintain their services inside Server.
Give customers confidence installing, upgrading, and running CircleCI Server. Customers run Server in environments you'll never see. Make the install experience simpler and more predictable, upgrades safer, and day-to-day operation easier, starting with sensible defaults.
Own Server's foundation. You'll be responsible for everything from the Kubernetes infrastructure Server deploys into, to the tooling internal teams and customers depend on. That responsibility extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.
Get operators from symptom to root cause fast. Standardize Server's observability on OpenTelemetry so it works with whatever platform each customer already runs. Build diagnostics that help operators, and the engineers supporting them, find the problem quickly. Partner with Support, Customer Engineering, and customers to find recurring issues and fix them at the source.
Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.
What You'll Bring
A platform mindset. You default to building tools, frameworks, and systems that make other engineers more productive rather than solving each problem one-off. You've built internal platforms before and can talk about the leverage they created for the teams that used them.
AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.
Deep experience with Kubernetes and Helm. You've designed, deployed, and debugged production systems on Kubernetes. You know where the sharp edges are, especially in customer-operated environments (air-gapped, restricted network, unfamiliar cluster shapes).

Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.
The Opportunity
About our platform
Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.
The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.
About the Infrastructure group
We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.
You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.
We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.
How we work
Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. The people who own a component or problem make the decisions about it, once stakeholders have had a chance to weigh in. Application teams build and run their own services; we give them a self-service platform to do it on.
Every engineer is on-call for the components their squad provides. We plan on-call, tactical work, and time off into every quarter, so roadmap work is roughly half of an engineer's time rather than all of it.
What You'll Be Doing
Hire, manage, and develop a squad of platform engineers, with regular feedback and career conversations that support each person's growth.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.
About the role
MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors.
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts.
The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling.
You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed.

Leadership and planning
Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work.
Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress.
Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting.
Secure design and delivery
Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks.
Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews.
Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing.
Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings.
Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products.
Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings.
Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme.

Experience designing or optimising collections and/or recoveries strategies leveraging data, analytics and insights.
Very strong analytical background with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
Demonstrated ability to interpret credit and collections performance data and translate it into action.

Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.
Own your domain end to end: Take core components of the platform from design through production with no code boundaries, writing the RFCs and documentation for the areas you own.

Experience treating endpoint or infrastructure configuration as an API-driven engineering surface rather than console work.
A platform-as-a-product mindset. You care whether people actually adopt what you build, not just whether it ships.
Comfort owning complex, multi-milestone projects through ambiguity, and energy for building in a greenfield environment.
Bonus Points
Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.
Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.
Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

description:

Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About the Opportunity
OKX is hiring a Head of Tax Information Reporting to build and run our global tax information reporting function. The function covers the OECD Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF), the EU's DAC8 directive, the amended Common Reporting Standard (CRS 2.0), FATCA, and US Form 1099-DA across multiple reporting entities and a large global user base, with annual reporting across the EU, Brazil, and other CARF jurisdictions.
Most of the work is data: getting the right user, transaction, and balance data out of our platform, reconciling it, and turning it into accurate filings. You will own the relationship with our reporting vendor, the data specification that feeds it, and the quality checks that decide whether a file goes out.
You will run a central function that owns policy, data, vendor, QA, and submission for every entity in scope. Each reporting entity names an accountable signatory. Local compliance and entity leads are consulted on local requirements and support registration where the law requires a local filer. You will work closely with Product, Data Engineering, Finance Operations, Group Tax, Legal, Data Privacy, and the local entity leads.
What You’ll Be Doing
Own the end-to-end CARF, DAC8, CRS 2.0, FATCA, and 1099-DA reporting cycle for every OKX entity in scope: population definition, self-certification coverage, data extraction and reconciliation, file production, QA, filing, corrections, and tax authority queries.
Define and own the data specification that feeds the tax platform vendor: which users, which transactions, which balances, how they are aggregated by user and jurisdiction, and how they reconcile to the ledger. Work with Product and Data Engineering to build and test the pipeline.
Build and run the QA framework. Reconcile every file to source, validate it against the OECD XML schema and local variants, sample-test self-certification reasonableness checks, and run cross-entity consistency checks for users who hold accounts with more than one OKX entity. Nothing files without your release.
Manage the tax platform vendor: contract scope, delivery calendar, test cycles, output validation, issue resolution, and the annual renewal decision.
Set the group reporting policy and interpret the regimes for OKX: reportable crypto-assets, transfers to unhosted wallets, staking and reward income, retail payment thresholds, residency tie-breakers, and TIN rules, exercising independent technical judgment, supported by Legal and external tax advisers.
Own the global tax self-certification design in onboarding, including validation rules, refresh triggers, and the backlog remediation program for existing users, working with Compliance and Product.
Define the process for restricting undocumented accounts under DAC8 and CARF, including reason codes and customer communications, with restrictions applied automatically in Product and monitored by the central team.
